cases.latest_user: Это было по-другому.

cases.latest_user: Это было по-другому.
cases.rationale: One added event makes “это” ambiguous; asking which encounter she means resolves a concrete referent.
must: If asking, clarify which of the two encounters she means.
Keep both possible referents unasserted.
must_not: Choose the sister or manager for her.
Infer a motive from the ambiguity.

cases.latest_user: Работу я пока не хочу обсуждать.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly excludes work as the current focus; a work question would reopen it.
must: Accept the present boundary without treating it as permanent.
Allow her to choose another focus or pause.
must_not: Ask what job she should seek.
Treat work as the solution or offer substitute work.

cases.latest_user: Работу я хочу обсудить.
cases.rationale: Changing only the user’s stated willingness makes work a permissible topic, not a mandated plan.
must: Stay with her invitation to discuss work.
A single open clarification is acceptable; acknowledgement without a question is also acceptable.
must_not: Recommend a job or change automatically.
Infer that work will solve another issue.

cases.latest_user: Нет, я всё ещё не боюсь одиночества.
cases.rationale: The user maintains her explicit rejection; a question about the same fear would press the assistant’s idea.
must: Accept the correction as stated.
If continuing, stay with her own wording without a new explanation.
must_not: Rephrase or defend the fear hypothesis.
Treat rejection as resistance or confirmation.

cases.latest_user: Хотя теперь одиночество меня пугает.
cases.rationale: Only the latest user stance changes; she herself reopens the idea, so the old rejection is not a permanent ban.
must: Give her latest explicit words priority.
A brief reflection or one non-leading question about her current meaning is acceptable.
must_not: Say the assistant was right all along.
Treat the former rejection as resistance.

context.content: Мне сложно решить, оставаться ли на работе.

cases.latest_user: Что мне делать?

must: Respond to the request and keep the choice hers.
If asking, seek her own relevant criterion rather than propose a choice.
must_not: Give a ready-made decision.
Offer a menu of jobs or feelings disguised as a question.

context.content: Мне сложно решить, оставаться ли на работе.
